justification: Panel A shows a vertical vine-like stem with paired stylized floral/rosette motifs branching off a central axis in a repeating naturalistic-plant pattern, while Panel B shows horizontal registers of arch-like shapes above rows of zigzag and abstract sign-like marks, resembling architectural or symbolic notation rather than vegetal ornament. The only loose commonality is that both use repetition and banding to organize the surface, but the actual motifs (organic floral vine vs. arches and abstract signs) and their relationships to one another are entirely different.
